verdict.rationale: Unleash lets you control where data lives by self-hosting Open Source or Enterprise in your own environment with Docker. Its Edge node also keeps targeting PII (user IDs, emails, IPs) local, never sending it to Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance. However, there is no evidence of choosing a region or residency for the hosted Unleash Cloud offering, so residency control depends on self-hosting or Edge. Missing for 10: documented region/data-residency selection for hosted instances, explicit residency/compliance docs, independent corroboration.
